ops.statement: Crews repeatedly background a long (>10 min) compute step and end their turn waiting on a monitor, stranding the run (3x this epic). A handoff that says 'run foreground' is not enough. Mitigations that worked: the Commander runs/polls the long step in the FOREGROUND itself and writes the crew's result; bake the quantitative gate into the test as the assertion so the long step is self-policing; and if the harness auto-backgrounds the Commander's own foreground command, poll its output file in-band to completion rather than ending the turn.

ops.statement:
The checklist engine refuses `start ` until that step's preconditions are attested ('REFUSED: preconditions unmet'). The reliable verb order per gated step is: attest --cond

--which preconditions -> start -> (do work / attach evidence) -> attest/advance (advance runs command/artifact postconditions and refuses on a missing review-result/APPROVE artifact). Attach the review-result APPROVE artifact to the integrate step itself, not only to the review step.
